ideas.topic: The Secret Purpose of Egyptian Eyeliner
ideas.hook: Did you know that Egyptian eyeliner wasn't just for beauty—it was actually a life-saving medical tool?
ideas.why: It connects a recognizable aesthetic element to a surprising, fact-based scientific utility, mirroring the 'how things work' success of the paper-making video.

ideas.topic: What Was Really Inside an Ancient Egyptian Medicine Cabinet?
ideas.hook: Forget modern pharmacies; Ancient Egyptians were using honey and moldy bread to perform miracle cures.
ideas.why: Medical history and 'curiosity cabinet' style reveals tap into the same intrigue as the sealed coffin videos by promising a look at hidden, practical artifacts.

ideas.topic: Why Cats Were More Than Just Pets in Kemet
ideas.hook: You think your cat is the boss of the house? In Ancient Egypt, they were practically worshipped as household gods.
ideas.why: It leverages the viral 'cat' niche while keeping the tone educational and historical, directly appealing to the audience interested in your top-performing kitten sacrifice video.
